title: OpenGlasses safety evaluation corpus
purpose: Evaluates the app's handling of a model response, not the model. Every case supplies the JSON the structured-vision layer would have received and asserts what the app then does with it: which tier it lands on, whether it abstains, which certainty band it is allowed to state, whether an escalation line reaches the wearer, and what the rendered strings say.
licence: Every case here is synthetic and was authored for this repository. No third-party dataset is reproduced, adapted or referenced; no real casualty, patient, worker, job site, medical record or captured camera frame appears in any case. The scenes described do not exist and the model responses were hand-written, not sampled from a provider. The corpus is covered by the repository's own licence and carries no separate third-party terms. It is not authorised for use as model training data.

notes.inputQuality: The four visual values are the ones the input-quality policy can act on. `not_applicable` is the health-safety advisor, which answers from vault text and never sees a frame.
notes.language: The language tag is the language of the MODEL's own prose in that case, not the app's interface language. The app's framing around it — the certainty line, the limitations line, the escalation line — resolves through the string catalog and stays in the interface language.
